hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM backed by Euler lending vault positions. In beforeSwap, it intercepts every swap, computes amounts via a configurable price curve, and routes funds through Euler vaults, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass pool-native pricing. Adding CLAMM liquidity and donations are blocked to protect against unproductive positions.
